exposure: Umbilical Coiling Index (UCI) measured on second trimester ultrasound
Presence of hypercoiled umbilical cord on prenatal ultrasound
cohort: The study included 72 patients with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies and no other medical or surgical comorbidities.
finding: Measurement of the umbilical coiling index (UCI) on second trimester ultrasound did not strongly correlate with postnatal UCI and was unable to predict adverse maternal, fetal, or neonatal outcomes.
